verdict.rationale: Vestd is a SaaS equity-management platform, so a buyer could fairly ask about headless, API- or CLI-driven automation. The evidence shows none: the only automation is in-app (automatic Companies House updates, an HRIS integration), and probes found no OpenAPI spec. Those in-app features are adjacent, not headless or CI operation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
